import copy
import unittest

from solution import prepare_notes


class PrepareNotesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_grouping_encoding_tokenization_and_order(self):
        rows = [
            {"group": "beta", "channel": "web", "priority": "low",
             "text": "First, NOTE!", "extra": {"keep": [1]}},
            {"group": "alpha", "channel": "web", "priority": "high",
             "text": "Hello---WORLD"},
            {"group": "beta", "channel": "web", "priority": "low",
             "text": "Second_part 42"},
            {"group": "alpha", "channel": "app", "priority": "low",
             "text": "  Mixed.Case  "},
        ]
        original = copy.deepcopy(rows)

        result = prepare_notes(rows)

        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"group_code": 0, "channel_code": 0, "priority_code": 1,
             "tokens": ["mixed", "case"]},
            {"group_code": 0, "channel_code": 1, "priority_code": 0,
             "tokens": ["hello", "world"]},
            {"group_code": 1, "channel_code": 1, "priority_code": 1,
             "tokens": ["first", "note", "second", "part", "42"]},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, original)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["tokens"], result[1]["tokens"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[1]["tokens"], result[2]["tokens"])
        result[2]["tokens"].append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(rows, original)

    def test_independent_lexicographic_codes(self):
        rows = [
            {"group": "z", "channel": "a", "priority": "m", "text": "one"},
            {"group": "a", "channel": "z", "priority": "a", "text": "two"},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(prepare_notes(rows), [
            {"group_code": 0, "channel_code": 1, "priority_code": 0,
             "tokens": ["two"]},
            {"group_code": 1, "channel_code": 0, "priority_code": 1,
             "tokens": ["one"]},
        ])

    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(prepare_notes([]), [])

    def test_empty_or_punctuation_only_text_produces_empty_tokens(self):
        result = prepare_notes([
            {"group": "g", "channel": "c", "priority": "p", "text": "--- !!"}
        ])
        self.assertEqual(result[0]["tokens"], [])

    def test_rejects_malformed_rows(self):
        invalid = [
            [1],
            [{}],
            [{"group": "g", "channel": "c", "priority": "p"}],
            [{"group": 1, "channel": "c", "priority": "p", "text": "x"}],
            [{"group": "g", "channel": None, "priority": "p", "text": "x"}],
            [{"group": "g", "channel": "c", "priority": [], "text": "x"}],
            [{"group": "g", "channel": "c", "priority": "p", "text": 4}],
        ]
        for rows in invalid:
            with self.subTest(rows=rows):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    prepare_notes(rows)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
